title: Gateway
description: How harness traffic reaches models: public URL, auth, model aliases and upstreams.

baseURL.description: What clients are pointed at (Kong's public listener).

auth.description: How clients obtain a credential for the auth gateway.

helperCommand.description: Command that prints a short-lived token (Claude apiKeyHelper, Codex env_key source, ...).

identityHeader.description: Header the auth gateway sets with the verified user id.

models.description: Stable alias (what clients request) to upstream target.

additionalProperties.description: Route for a model alias: either upstream+model, or an ordered/weighted list of targets (not both).

upstream.description: Name of an entry in gateway.upstreams. Required unless engine is external.

model.description: Provider model id or Bedrock inference profile ARN.

items.description: One provider target. Targets sharing a priority form a tier: weights split traffic within it (sticky per identity+session) and the rest of the tier is the failover order; later tiers are tried only after earlier ones fail (connect error, 5xx or 429, before any response byte).

upstream.description: Name of an entry in gateway.upstreams. Required unless engine is external.

model.description: Provider model id, Bedrock inference profile ARN, or Azure deployment name.

weight.description: Relative share of traffic within the priority tier.

timeoutSeconds.description: Connect plus response-header timeout for this target; streams are not time-limited afterwards.

url.description: Base URL of the backend (optional for kind vertex: derived from region).

kind.description: Backend type. vertex: Anthropic models on Google Vertex AI (ADC auth). azure-openai: Azure OpenAI Responses (credential required).

region.description: AWS SigV4 region for kind bedrock (default: parsed from a bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com host); Google Cloud region (e.g. us-east5, or global) for kind vertex.

apiVersion.description: api-version query for kind azure-openai; empty uses the versionless /openai/v1 surface.

credential.description: Where halo-proxy reads the provider key (kinds openai, azure-openai): an environment variable name or a file path, never the secret itself.

env.description: Environment variable on the halo-proxy host.

file.description: Secret file path on the halo-proxy host.

scheme.description: Header style: api-key (default for azure-openai) or bearer (default for openai).

serves.description: Kind orchestrator only: the client wires this upstream answers. Validate warns about a harness routed to an orchestrator that does not declare its wire.

engine.description: Data plane enforcing this policy (default halo-proxy). external is a gateway Halos does not run (your own API gateway): clients are rendered with each alias's provider model id. Multi-target routes (weights, failover) run only in halo-proxy; halo-kong and external use each route's first target.

pricing.description: USD per million tokens, keyed by provider model id (the model a route target names). Costs gateway usage for budgets; a routed model without a price counts tokens but $0.

outputPerMTok.description: Output tokens, including reasoning or thinking tokens.

budgets.description: Spend caps enforced by halo-proxy, with halo-server holding the counters (ADR-0017).

items.description: One budget: a limit in USD and/or tokens per scope key over a window.

scope.description: Counter key: user (per verified subject), group (per listed group), ring (per ring) or org (one shared counter).

groups.description: Scope group: the groups that each get a counter (required). Other scopes: count only callers in one of these groups.

rings.description: Count only callers routed to these rings (default every ring).

window.description: day, week (from Monday) or month: calendar windows in UTC. rolling: the last period.

period.description: Rolling window length as a Go duration between 1h and 2160h, e.g. 24h. Rolling only.

limitUSD.description: Spend cap in USD for the window, priced from pricing.

limitTokens.description: Token cap for the window (input + output + cache reads and writes).

action.description: When exhausted: warn (response header and metric; the request passes) or enforce (HTTP 429 with Retry-After at the window reset). Default warn.

alertAt.description: Soft thresholds as fractions of the limit (default [0.8]): a header and a metric when crossed.

else.description: Unless engine is external, routes name an upstream and upstreams are required.
